# leaflet-tual v2

> Opinionated whiteboard-style annotation toolset (pen, arrows, shapes, notes, text, rulers, pages) for Leaflet maps. Everything stored in geographic coordinates.

Draw on a map the way you draw on a design canvas. Coordinates are always `GeoPoint` (`{ lat, lng }`), keeping annotations attached to the ground while the map pans and zooms.

## Navigation & Quick Links
- Website: https://leaflet-tual.dev
- Interactive Demo: https://leaflet-tual.dev/demo
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/yusufarsln98/leaflet-tual
- npm Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/leaflet-tual
- SKILL.md Specification: https://leaflet-tual.dev/SKILL.md

## Core Invariants & Rules
1. **Store geography, never pixels.** Every persisted coordinate is a `GeoPoint` (`{ lat, lng }`). Never put screen `{ x, y }` in an item.
2. **Do geometry in world space.** Aspect locks, 45° snapping, circle radii, curve offsets, hit tests and resizing run in a zoom-independent plane (`toWorld` / `fromWorld`), never in current-zoom pixels. Squares stay square and curves keep their shape at every zoom level and latitude.
3. **Use the built-in style values.** Colors are palette names, widths are `'s' | 'm' | 'l'`, text sizes are `'s' | 'm' | 'l' | 'xl'`. Do not store hex colors or pixel sizes in items.
4. **Change the look through tokens**, not by overriding library internals with CSS selectors.
5. **Every UI word is a translation token.** Provide custom `translations` or set default tokens.
6. **Change the toolbar through the `toolbar` prop.**
7. **One document, one change callback.** State is a plain JSON `Doc`. Save from `onChange` only when `info.committed` is `true`.
8. **Controlled or uncontrolled, never both.** Pass `value` or `defaultValue`. Undo and redo work in both modes and report through `onChange`.
9. **Mutate through the controller** (`add`, `update`, `remove`). Never edit `doc` or `items` in place.
10. **Modifiers are built in.** `Shift` locks aspect (1:1) and snaps angles to 45°. `Alt` resizes from the center.
11. **Validate untrusted JSON** with `parseDoc(input)` before `load`.
12. **Map context.** Inside `<MapContainer>`, `<LeafletTual>` finds the map itself. Outside it, pass `map={mapInstance}`.

## Data Model

```ts
export type GeoPoint = { lat: number; lng: number }

export interface Doc {
  version: 2
  page: string          // id of the active page
  pages: Page[]
}

export interface Page {
  id: string
  name: string
  view?: { center: GeoPoint; zoom: number }
  items: Item[]
}

export type ColorName =
  | 'ink' | 'gray' | 'taupe' | 'red' | 'orange'
  | 'yellow' | 'green' | 'blue' | 'purple' | 'pink'

export interface Style {
  color?: ColorName
  width?: 's' | 'm' | 'l'
  dash?: 'solid' | 'dashed' | 'dotted'
  fill?: 'none' | 'tint' | 'solid'
  size?: 's' | 'm' | 'l' | 'xl'
  weight?: 'regular' | 'bold'
  fontStyle?: 'normal' | 'italic'
  textDecoration?: 'none' | 'underline'
  underline?: boolean
  list?: 'none' | 'bullet'
  bullets?: boolean
  align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right'
}

export type ArrowKind = 'linear' | 'curved' | 'elbow' | 's-curve'
export type Head = 'triangle' | 'open' | 'none'
export type ShapeKind =
  | 'square' | 'circle' | 'star' | 'actor'
  | 'triangle' | 'diamond' | 'hexagon' | 'marker'
export type LabelPosition = 'top' | 'center' | 'bottom'

export interface ArrowItem {
  id: string
  type: 'arrow'
  kind: ArrowKind
  from: GeoPoint
  to: GeoPoint
  via?: GeoPoint
  heads?: { start?: Head; end?: Head }
  label?: string
  style?: Style
  createdAt: number
}

export interface ShapeItem {
  id: string
  type: 'shape'
  kind: ShapeKind
  at: GeoPoint
  width: number
  height: number
  label?: string
  labelPosition?: LabelPosition   // default 'center'
  style?: Style
  createdAt: number
}

export interface FreedrawItem {
  id: string
  type: 'freedraw'
  points: GeoPoint[]
  style?: Style
  createdAt: number
}

export interface PenPoint {
  at: GeoPoint
  in?: GeoPoint     // incoming bezier control point (absolute geography)
  out?: GeoPoint    // outgoing bezier control point (absolute geography)
}

export interface PenItem {
  id: string
  type: 'pen'
  points: PenPoint[]
  closed?: boolean
  style?: Style
  createdAt: number
}

export interface RulerItem {
  id: string
  type: 'ruler'
  from: GeoPoint
  to: GeoPoint
  unit?: 'metric' | 'imperial'
  label?: string
  style?: Style
  createdAt: number
}

export interface NoteItem {
  id: string
  type: 'note'
  at: GeoPoint
  width?: number
  height?: number
  title?: string
  text: string
  style?: Style
  createdAt: number
}

export interface TextItem {
  id: string
  type: 'text'
  at: GeoPoint
  text: string
  style?: Style
  createdAt: number
}

export type Item =
  | ArrowItem | ShapeItem | FreedrawItem | PenItem | RulerItem
  | NoteItem | TextItem
```

Pen paths remain editable after drawing: with the Select tool, drag an anchor or a bezier control handle to reshape the path. Dragging one control handle mirrors the opposite handle around its anchor.

## Quick Start (React)

```tsx
import { MapContainer, TileLayer } from 'react-leaflet'
import { LeafletTual } from 'leaflet-tual/react'
import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css'
import 'leaflet-tual/styles.css'

export function MapView() {
  return (
    <MapContainer center={[41.01, 28.97]} zoom={13} style={{ height: '100vh' }}>
      <TileLayer url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png" />
      <LeafletTual onChange={(doc, { committed }) => committed && save(doc)} />
    </MapContainer>
  )
}
```

## Vanilla JS Core (No React)

```ts
import L from 'leaflet'
import { createLeafletTual, emptyDoc } from 'leaflet-tual'
import 'leaflet-tual/styles.css'

const map = L.map('map').setView([41.01, 28.97], 13)
const tual = createLeafletTual(map, {
  defaultValue: emptyDoc(),
  toolbar: { position: 'top-left' },
  onChange: (doc, info) => info.committed && save(doc),
})

tual.setTool('freedraw') // or tual.setTool('pen') for the bezier pen
tual.on('select', (items) => console.log(items))
// cleanup
tual.destroy()
```

## Controller API (`useLeafletTual` & `createLeafletTual`)

State:
- `doc: Doc`
- `items: Item[]`
- `tool: ToolId`
- `variant: string | null`
- `style: Style`
- `selection: string[]`
- `selected: Item[]`
- `theme: 'light' | 'dark' | 'system'`
- `readOnly: boolean`
- `canUndo: boolean`
- `canRedo: boolean`
- `translations: TranslationTokens`

Actions:
- `setTool(tool, variant?)`
- `setStyle(patch)` (selection-aware)
- `setTheme(theme)`
- `setTranslations(patch)`
- `add(item)`
- `update(id, patch, committed?)`
- `updateMany(patches, committed?)`
- `duplicate(ids?)`
- `reorder(ids, action)`
- `remove(ids?)`
- `clear()`
- `select(ids)`
- `edit(id)`
- `undo()` / `redo()`
- `fit(target)` ('all', 'selection', or item id)
- `load(doc)`
- `setReadOnly(boolean)`
- `pages.list`, `pages.active`, `pages.add(name?)`, `pages.rename(id, name)`, `pages.remove(id)`, `pages.move(id, toIndex)`, `pages.select(id)`

## Geometry Utilities
- `toWorld(geo)` / `fromWorld(point)`: Spherical Mercator world meters projection
- `geoToScreen(map, geo)` / `screenToGeo(map, point)`
- `lockAspect(anchor, target, ratio = 1)` (world space)
- `snapAngle(anchor, target, step = 45)` (world space)
- `defaultVia(from, to, curvature = 0.25)` (world space)
- `distance(a, b)` / `pathDistance(points)` / `formatDistance(meters, unit, tokens?)`
- `bounds(item)` / `hitTest(item, point, tolerance)`
- `resolveColor(name)`
